title: If you lose your phone
summary: The last step before the account is made. It asks for an optional recovery e-mail, or the platform's own account (Apple on iOS, Google on Android, ADR 0096), as a way back into the account if the phone is lost. The person can skip it.

phase.description: choose: the two buttons. email: the e-mail field is open.

emailInvalid.description: true after submit when the address is not plausible. Shows bipe_signup_email_invalid.

linkProvider.description: The platform's own provider when GET /v1/links/providers offers a path for it on this platform, else none.

linkChosen.description: true after linkAccount: the link runs right after signup-create made the account.

submitEmail.effect: Checks the address locally, then goes to signup-create with the e-mail.

skip.effect: Goes to signup-create without an e-mail.

linkAccount.effect: Sets linkChosen and goes to signup-create without an e-mail. After the account exists, the linked-accounts link steps run for linkProvider, without the owner check (the person is making the account now). A failed or cancelled link does not stop the sign-up: linked-accounts offers it again in settings.

notes: The e-mail is a recovery fallback, never a login (ADR 0057). It goes to POST /v1/signup as email; the server sends a link to confirm it.
Guardians and the recovery key are offered later, from settings, not here (onboarding.md: the fallback prompt comes after the first chat when skipped).
The link button shows only when linkProvider is not none. Apple on iOS needs the Sign in with Apple capability; Google on Android uses the web flow.
